LanguageData.MST.pawnGroupMakersComment: Raid composition structure: each group maker pairs a kindDef (which generation logic) with a commonality (relative chance this pool is picked), and lists its pawn options with weights plus a point cap. The per-pawn price is PawnKindDef.combatPower, not editable here.
LanguageData.MST.maxTotalPointsComment: This group maker is only usable when raid points are at or below this value. Vanilla default 9999999 means unlimited.
LanguageData.MST.disallowedStrategiesComment: Raid strategies (siege, breaching, ...) that may not use this group maker. Empty = no restriction.
LanguageData.MST.optionsComment: Pawn options for this pool (PawnGenOption: kind + selection weight). Only the Normal / Shamblers worker reads it.
LanguageData.MST.PawnGroupMakerNoOptions: This group maker has no options, so it cannot produce any pawns.
LanguageData.MST.PawnGroupMakerDropped: Dropped {0} group maker(s) with no kind set
